# Bundled zlib for Windows x64

The `windows-x64` headers and static library are zlib 1.3.1, built by vcpkg
for the `x64-windows-static` triplet from the official source release:

https://github.com/madler/zlib/archive/v1.3.1.tar.gz

The source archive SHA-256 is
`17e88863f3600672ab49182f217281b6fc4d3c762bde361935e436a95214d05c`.
The bundled `zlib.lib` SHA-256 is
`4eaafe0899dcc4b8a3194ee3a221c6fbb6a1707c2d020a932f429176ce2854d6`.
The upstream license is in `LICENSE` here.
